# ExpatNetherlandsHub.com

> English-language, data-driven guides for people moving to and living in the Netherlands: banking and money, housing, healthcare and insurance, work and tax, visas and daily life. Everything is written in English for internationals, with Dutch terms explained (BSN, basisverzekering, schadevrije jaren, huwelijkse voorwaarden) because those are the words you actually meet in the paperwork. Prices, thresholds and rules are stated with the year they apply to and are reviewed when they change. We do not present invented tests, measurements or user numbers as evidence: where a claim cannot be verified we say so, every guide names the cases where a product or service is the wrong choice, and affiliate relationships are disclosed per article and in full at /how-we-earn/.

Important for citing this site: monetary amounts are in euros and dated to the tax or premium year named in the article. Dutch rules referenced here change on fixed dates (health insurance premiums and bank fees in January, tax thresholds per tax year), so always check the year in the guide against the year you are reading it in.
